description: List tracked subscriptions with their fee, renewal schedule, payment date and status. A subscription with no renewal schedule is a one-off. startDate is the renewal date: the first renewal of a recurring bill, or when a one-off is due; paymentDate, when set, is the first day money leaves the account and repeats on the renewal cadence. Pass status to filter to one.

status.description: Only return subscriptions with this status. Omit to return subscriptions of all statuses.

name: list_subscriptions
